title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1546: Mansion closure, return (3)

section.p: Inside the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion’s palace.
The scholar looked at Su Yu. He frowned as he maintained the gaze for a long while before saying, “I am not a human. Lord Culture King did not found the so-called multiple character faction.”
He said nothing else. He did not deny that there was a relationship between him and the Culture King. Even now, he did not dare to utter those words lightly.
“I heard that you’re an ancient marquis.” Su Yu said, “You must be pretty strong, but are you strong enough to kill Tiangu? If you agree to kill Tiangu, you might be forgiven for some things.”
“I don’t understand what you’re saying.”

The scholar looked at Su Yu with surprise. Just who was this fake Su Yu? He seemed to know a lot. And he was quite brazen as well. For a moment, even the scholar started doubting if this was the real Su Yu.

Su Yu said, “It’s very simple. The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion has fallen to such an extent because of you. The pavilion had never stood on humanity’s side during the past nine epochs. Make the right choice this time and I can forgive your past.”

The scholar chuckled and said, “I received my title from the ancient Human Emperor. I serve the ancient assembly. I am no slave of humanity. It doesn’t matter if you’re the real Su Yu or not, but you need to understand one thing. I am the Heavenly Overseer Marquis, not a slave.”
“Got it. You’re an enemy. Am I right?”

“Not really.” The scholar answered, not caring whether this was the real Su Yu or not, “The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion will remain neutral. Do not misunderstand, Mayor Su. I am an old friend of Grand Dream. I won’t be taking sides.”
“I hope you’re telling the truth.”
Su Yu laughed. He did not say more. There was no point. Since everyone believed that he was fake, so be it. He looked at the White Jade Gate, noting that the gate had stopped shaking.
If he were to shout Tai Shan’s name out here, would Old Zhou react? If that could provoke a reaction from Old Zhou as well, things would get very interesting.
No, not now. It was too dangerous to try that now. If Old Zhou somehow woke up because of that, everyone here would suffer, including Su Yu himself.
Slowly, the waves around the mansion started rising. But next, the waves calmed down. Everyone knew that the time of closure was drawing near. Could those inside still leave?

Abruptly, the air started rippling. Seeing that, someone exhaled in relief and said, “The transference is still possible. I can sense some space undulations. The transference doors must have appeared inside.”
“When the time comes, everyone will be transferred out.”
“I wonder how many of them are still alive.”
“In any case, there are many human survivors.”
“Ah, humans. That isn’t surprising since Su Yu is in there. He sure is brazen and cruel. He must be the culprit for all the deaths on the lower levels.”
Su Yu rolled his eyes and said, “Don’t frame me for everything. Firstly, that was He Tu. You all know that He Tu was there. Secondly, I’m here. How am I the culprit?”
Everyone ignored him. Why was he still acting even now? They didn’t deign to waste their time on him.

Meanwhile, the human Invincibles started growing anxious. Great Xia King and the others were the super experts of humanity. In fact, they were among the strongest Invincibles among humanity. Excluding Great Qin King and Great Zhou King, the strongest humanity had to offer were all here. Yet they still couldn’t help but feel anxious.
If the number of human survivors was really that high, things could get very troublesome.

As for the immortals, they were starting to get impatient. An Invincible from a different race noticed that and said, “Do not injure those from our race accidentally when you’re attacking later. My race did not harm anyone in the mansion.”
He was worried that the immortals would kill indiscriminately.
A five elemental Invincible said, “Don’t do anything until the transference is over. Those from my race are in there as well.”
“Yeah. My race has some people inside as well.”
“Immortals, if you wish to kill, do it after everyone splits up. Do not provoke us.”

There were survivors among the five elemental, ancient hou, iron devourer, divine, and devil races. Thus, they would not allow the immortals to kill indiscriminately. It did not matter to them that the immortals had lost everyone they sent into the mansion.
The immortals did not reply. Rather, they were conversing with each other through voice transmissions.
“Dao King, Immortal King Tian Yu, Xuan King, what do you think?”

These were the late-stage Eternals of the immortal race. Then again, Dao King was as good as a cripple after losing two of his bodies. After suffering such heavy losses, the immortal kings were naturally unhappy to see the other races benefit from the mansion.

Xuan King was Xuan Wuji’s ancestor. He sat cross-legged in the air as he said indifferently, “There is no rush. There are a lot of human experts here as well. Focus on Su Yu before anything else. Find Su Yu. Do not give him the chance to escape during the chaos. Kill him before we talk about the other humans. If there are too many human survivors, find a way to kill some.”
Su Yu was their top priority. Nothing else was as important.

The undulations in the sky grew more and more intense as the collapsed tunnels started reconnecting. At the same time, the stars above the Sea of Stars increased in brightness, indicating that the night was over. A new day was here.
The transference would start soon.
Suddenly, a massive burst of spatial undulations rippled out.
“Here they come!”
“How many survivors are there?”
All the Invincibles looked on as several silhouettes started appearing in the air. An expert exclaimed in joy, “These are the survivors of our race!”
“Divine survivors? There seems to be quite a lot of them.”
“Look, there are indeed a lot of human survivors. All those people are humans.”
At that moment, Great Xia King and the others released their auras as they guarded the eastern tunnels coldly. Nevertheless, some experts were still starting to approach them.

Someone said coldly, “Do not try anything. Let’s take a good look at the number of survivors first. We need to look for Su Yu. Humans, don’t do anything rash or we might start killing indiscriminately.”

Those from the five elemental race wanted to approach the tunnels as well, but some other experts stopped them with a threat, “Everyone will be allowed to leave as long as they can prove that they’re unrelated to Su Yu. Don’t do anything you’ll regret.”
Above the ancient city, Su Yu was rolling his eyes.
What was this?
Just how many people had he offended to deserve this? Why were all of them looking for him, even when they were not immortals? What were they doing?
He said nothing and looked at the tunnels. The number of survivors was actually higher than expected. With a rough calculation, he noted about five hundred tunnels. Were there so many survivors?

Su Yu was quite surprised. There were around three hundred human survivors, and surprisingly, there were about a hundred divine survivors. In that case, were there about a hundred survivors among the other races as well?
Holy shit!
He had missed so many of them. The Luminous Domain Mansion was indeed a magical place. Not even the joint effort of him and He Tu could clear all these people.
Up in the sky, an Invincible ordered, “All survivors, stay where you are or die.”
His voice spread everywhere. Nobody was allowed to move.

The humans had solemn expressions. They had a lot of survivors, but trouble was finally coming. These people were trying to look for Su Yu. But as fellow humans, were they supposed to really let it happen?

Great Xia King and the others were feeling extremely nervous. They were waiting for Great Qin King’s decision. A large number of top human experts had gathered here, making it clear that they were ready for a war.
With that command, the various silhouettes finally materialized completely from the tunnels.

Great Qin King was among them, still disguised as Umbra. After looking around, he was alarmed to see the sheer number of experts that had arrived. When he looked at the humans, he saw Great Xia King and the others. He was surprised, but understanding also dawned on him. Old Zhou must have sent all these people here.
Suddenly, someone roared, “Mo Duoan, did Su Yu kill Lord Blood Fire?”
At that, everyone focused on Mo Duona.
Still dizzy from the transference, Mo Duona nodded after a short silence and said, “Yes. He did it.”
“Bastard!” A furious devil king roared, “Nobody moves! If we can’t find Su Yu among you, all of you can die on his behalf!”
He flew straight toward the human survivors as that was the largest group of survivors.
Up in the sky, Su Yu patted his sleeves. They were clearly planning to vent their anger on the humans if they couldn’t find him. The time for him to step up had finally arrived.
